precepts.text: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted; when we break God's laws he calls us fools.
precepts.point: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me. Israel is afflicted because of sin, but the affliction has not prevailed, because we have been in and out of captivity through repentance.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

precepts.why: “Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth”. Israel is afflicted because of sin: “Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.” When we break God’s laws he calls us fools, and the affliction follows the transgression.

precepts.text: Iniquities prevail against me; as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
precepts.point: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me. Israel is afflicted because of sin, but the affliction has not prevailed, because we have been in and out of captivity through repentance.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

precepts.why: “Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.” Iniquities prevail, but the affliction has not: “yet they have not prevailed against me.” The Most High purges our transgressions away, and that is why we have been in and out of captivity through repentance.

points: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say. Israel has always been afflicted from its youth, yet they have not prevailed against us.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

points: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me. Israel is afflicted because of sin, but the affliction has not prevailed, because we have been in and out of captivity through repentance.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

points: The plowers plowed upon my back; they made long their furrows. This describes the affliction laid upon Israel.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

points: The Lord is righteous; he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

points: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion. The them who hate Zion are the wicked; let the wicked be confounded and turned back.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

points: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up. The wicked and the enemies are like grass on a housetop; it has no deep root, so it never reaches its full potential or full growth.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

points: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand, nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom. There is nothing to gather from the wicked.

note.label: Psalm 129: Many a Time Have They Afflicted Me

points: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you. Zion goes by and does not bless the wicked; we bless in the name of the Lord.
